name: Mridangam Adi tala theka
desc: Carnatic mridangam sarva-laghu in Adi tala (8 aksharas): sam alternates thom/dhum each cycle, a nam-dhin theka layer with ghost gains, a ki finger-stroke euclid that rotates through four positions, a slow filter breath and opposite-phase pan drift, and a lastOf(4) korvai that doubles the cycle at phrase ends. Peak walks the whole cycle with iter and a gumki slide.

code.sparse: stack(s("<mridangam_thom mridangam_dhum> ~ mridangam_tha ~ mridangam_thom ~ mridangam_tha ~").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5, ${cut}).slow(32)), s("mridangam_ki(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.2).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(16))).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("<mridangam_thom mridangam_dhum> ~ mridangam_tha mridangam_ki mridangam_thom ~ mridangam_tha ~").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.25).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.55, ${cut}*1.15).slow(32)), s("mridangam_nam ~ mridangam_dhin ~ mridangam_nam ~ mridangam_ki mridangam_ta").gain("[.5 .28]*4").shape(.2).pan(sine.range(.45,.55).slow(24)), s("mridangam_ki(5,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.2).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<mridangam_thom mridangam_dhum> mridangam_ta mridangam_tha mridangam_ki mridangam_thom mridangam_ta mridangam_tha mridangam_ki").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.65, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)), s("mridangam_nam mridangam_ki mridangam_dhin mridangam_ta mridangam_nam mridangam_ki mridangam_ta mridangam_ki").gain("[.5 .3 .42 .28]*2").shape(.22).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(24)), s("mridangam_ki(7,16,<0 4 8 12>)").gain(.22).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(12)), s("mridangam_gumki(3,8,<0 2>)").gain(.3).lastOf(2, x=>x.ply(2))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).iter(4).fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
